lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 1-2: four matching bar-back chairs, plain curved mid-rail (no carving), reeded/faceted tapering front legs with ring turning, drop-in seats in modern cream damask. Photo 3: front corner close-up shows knocks and edge wear to the seat rail and leg, finish worn at the corner. Rear legs appear to be plain sabre shape. No obvious breaks visible.
lots.condition: Used, structurally plausible from photos; modern reupholstery; edge wear and knocks to seat rails and legs. Joints and any repairs not seen.
lots.question_for_gowans: Are all four chairs firm at the joints, with no broken or replaced back legs or cracked top rails? Any obvious later repairs (screws, brackets, new timber)? At viewing, check the underside of the seat rails for corner blocks and matching construction across all four.
